Laura / team — quick legal note and suggested redline language. We can support invoicing Ledgerly EMEA, but require:

- Confirmatory documentation: valid VAT registration number for Ledgerly EMEA (the attached cert is a start; we need the VAT ID to validate against VIES)
- An explicit tax representation in the Order Form (see option A / B below)
- Net terms: net60 increases DSO risk. If we accept net60, require a commercial concession (e.g., 45-day commit prepay or 5% price uplift). Prefer net45 or escrow for the first invoice.

Suggested Order Form language (pick one):

Option A — Entity invoicing (customer-elected invoicing entity):
"Customer may designate an invoicing entity for the Services. If Customer elects an entity other than Redwood's contracting party, Customer represents and warrants that such entity is duly registered for VAT and will provide Redwood with valid tax registration documentation. Customer shall be responsible for all local taxes, duties, and withholding obligations associated with payments to such entity."

Option B — US invoicing + tax indemnity:
"Redwood will invoice the contracting party named in the MSA. If Customer requests invoicing to a different legal entity for their internal purposes, Customer shall promptly provide tax residency documentation and agree to indemnify Redwood for any taxes, withholding, penalties, or duties arising from such invoicing elections."

Practical ask: ask Ledgerly to confirm the VAT number and whether they expect reverse-charge treatment. If reverse-charge applies and we have a validated VAT ID, we can invoice the EU entity and mark the invoice accordingly. If not, insist on net45 or an upfront partial payment.

I'll attach a short .docx with the redlines for review.

— Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference

2) Payment terms: our standard offer is net45. If Ledgerly requires net60, we'd need either (a) a one-time 3% prepayment on the first invoice, or (b) a 6-month prepay of 25% of the committed spend.

- Whether procurement can accept net45 (preferred) or whether you need net60 (we'll then propose the prepay mechanics).
